types.description: Blue plain-lens pilot-light head, Harmony metal, 22 mm; for integral-LED body

document.title: Control and Signaling — Harmony style 4 pilot-light heads
document.revision: April 2004; Schneider Electric / Telemecanique; Farnell mirror

modelingNotes: Exact historical order ZB4-BV063 is a blue plain-lens head for a body comprising an integral LED; mass 0.026 kg. The 10/2021 catalog p.67 prints the matching head as ZB4BV063.

Mechanical/optical head only. No LED light block, contacts, transformer or fixing collar is included in this abstraction. No lamp supply terminals, electrical ratings or circuit functions are assigned.

The exact 2025 product sheet identifies a chromium-plated metal bezel and 22 mm mounting diameter. Its P1/P2 composition drawings describe compatible light-block arrangements, not installed head terminals.
No documented fixed electrical links. Protective bonding through the head, panel or attachment hardware is unresolved and is not asserted. Use an accessory documentation view.

connectionCoverage.notes: Zero documented electrical terminals on the selected mechanical head. Manufacturer evidence separates the head from the light-source body. The metal head's protective-bond and attachment interface is not established; an exhaustive empty physical inventory or installed bond is not claimed.
